professional_identity.professional_summary: Pradeep Selladurai is a Cyber Security undergraduate transitioning into AI Engineering. His primary interests include Agentic AI, Voice AI, Context Engineering, LLM Applications, Prompt Engineering, Multi-Agent Systems, and Real-Time AI Experiences. He focuses on building practical AI systems rather than only learning theoretical concepts.

career_journey.why_cyber_security: After completing higher secondary education, I selected Cyber Security because it appeared to be an exciting and growing field. At that time I did not have complete clarity about my long-term career path.
career_journey.ai_discovery: During my second year of engineering I started exploring Artificial Intelligence and became increasingly interested in how intelligent systems work.
career_journey.transition_to_ai: During my third year I joined an AI-focused company where I worked on Agentic AI projects, Voice AI systems, and real-world AI applications. This experience shifted my primary focus from Cyber Security to AI Engineering.
career_journey.current_direction: I am currently focused on becoming an AI Engineer with expertise in Agentic AI, Voice AI, Context Engineering, and LLM-powered applications.

learning_style.learning_philosophy: Build -> Break -> Debug -> Research -> Improve -> Build Again
learning_style.description: I prefer learning through practical implementation rather than only studying theory. I enjoy building systems, identifying limitations, debugging issues, researching solutions, and continuously improving my implementations.
